content_fields.title: Enforce object-level ownership checks on every resource access (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Check object ownership on every resource access, not only the caller's role.
content_fields.finding: No ownership predicate is applied to the queried Order before it is serialized back.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/orders/services/get_order_service.py
db_order = (
    db.query(Order)
    .filter(Order.id == order_id, Order.user_id == current_user.id)
    .first()
)
if db_order is None:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")
criteria: Ownership is expressed as a query filter so the object is never loaded without it.
The same pattern is applied to orders, coupons and profile access.
